summary: Guard Dog M1 iteration 4 — post-resign state (v25) and new recovery/report UI verified end-to-end against the public URL https://guard-dog-m1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend: full pytest suite (all 15 files) runs green with GD_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 — 107 passed, 1 skipped (TestSigningHappyPath, correctly gated on GD_ALLOW_LIVE_RESIGN); no bundle-version drift. New /app/backend/tests/test_m1_iter4_post_resign.py (11 tests, all passing) locks the post-resign invariants: (1) GET /api/config returns controlledEndpoint {host:'blocktest.btciq.app', ipv4:'52.25.179.131', url:'https://blocktest.btciq.app/', isPlaceholder:false} with signing.enabled=true, requiresConfirm=true, allowedRulesets=['gd-m1-controlled-block'] and no private-material / admin-token leaks in body; (2) GET /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest returns bundleVersion=25, keyId='gd-m1-test-ed25519-001', payloadHash='2581666cc768e1e4e76962db0cc70e497e17e9b9cf4a5a997c8cfb091e6b90c9' (independently recomputed as sha256(JCS(payload)) — matches), signature (88 chars) verifies with cryptography.Ed25519PublicKey against the PINNED public 'ccf41NL6VHYQsH171Lw98hKiIoQFvAY0t171X4PL/ac=' over JCS(unsigned envelope), payload.rules == [{ruleId:'m1-controlled-block-001', host:'blocktest.btciq.app', action:'block', ...}]; (3) GET /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/versions max(bundleVersion)==25 and no '_id' fields; (4) GET /api/keys lists both 001 and 002 (001 pubkey matches the pin) with no privateKey/seed/secret; (5) POST /api/intelligence/lookup {url:'https://BlockTest.BTCIQ.app/x?token=SECRET'} -> verdict='block', source='local-signed-rules', sanitizedUrl='https://blocktest.btciq.app/x' and 'SECRET' absent from response; unknown-host lookup -> verdict='unknown', degraded=true; (6) Signing guard (non-mutating): anonymous 401, wrong token 401, admin+confirm=false 409 (CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED), rulesetId='gd-other-ruleset'+confirm=true 403 (RULESET_NOT_ALLOWED); bundle still v25 after all guard calls (asserted). Frontend (Expo web preview, viewport 390x844): harness-screen loads with zero console errors and no red screen. Backend card shows Ruleset='gd-m1-controlled-block', Controlled host='blocktest.btciq.app', Dedicated IPv4='52.25.179.131', Signing key='gd-m1-test-ed25519-001', Bundle version='v25 · 1 rule(s)', payloadHash prefix '2581666cc768e1e4e76962db0cc70e49…' — all exact matches. analyze-url-input pre-filled with 'https://blocktest.btciq.app/login?token=SECRET'; clicking 'Analyze locally' returns verdict='block (m1-controlled-block-001)' and sanitizedUrl='https://blocktest.btciq.app/login' (token stripped). 'Run proof' emits the six honest steps observed on-screen: config PASS ('Injected controlled endpoint config' — blocktest.btciq.app -> 52.25.179.131), bundle PASS ('Backend served signed bundle' — v25 keyId=gd-m1-test-ed25519-001 rules=1), verify BLOCKED ('native verifier unavailable in this runtime'), before PASS ('reachable (opaque cross-origin response)'), consent BLOCKED (requestPermission(vpn) 'unsupported'), start SKIPPED; harness-verdict text = 'Proof incomplete: requires Android native build + real controlled endpoint.'; blocked-count remains '0' both before and after the run; [data-testid="event-THREAT_BLOCKED"] is NOT in the DOM (nothing simulated). 'Build JSON evidence' populates the report: proof-complete='no — milestone open', recovery-complete='no', enforcementEvidenceId='none', report-json-uri='JSON: shown below (web: no file system)'; report JSON includes signedBundle {rulesetId:'gd-m1-controlled-block', bundleVersion:25, keyId:'gd-m1-test-ed25519-001', payloadHash:'2581666cc768e1e4e76962db0cc70e497e17e9b9cf4a5a997c8cfb091e6b90c9'} and routeActivation.status='SKIPPED' with detail='prerequisites not met; nothing started, nothing claimed'; the report-recovery row is NOT rendered (protection never started, recovery=null — exactly per spec). Export PDF button is enabled (aria-disabled not set). 'Stop protection' click on web does not crash. Bundle re-checked after all UI+backend tests: still v25 with the single controlled rule.
critical_code_review_comments: androidBlockingProofHarness.ts still uses a heuristic to compute isPlaceholder (host.endsWith('.example')). Post-resign this coincides with backend controlled_endpoint_is_placeholder=false for blocktest.btciq.app, but the two signals remain independent. Consider consuming config.controlledEndpoint.isPlaceholder from GET /api/config directly to eliminate drift risk if a future placeholder is chosen from a non-'.example' TLD. Reference: /app/frontend/src/harness/androidBlockingProofHarness.ts.

test_m1_iter3_real_endpoint.py asserts bundleVersion>17 which will continue to pass at v25 and beyond, but a companion equality (or upper bound) assertion in the iter3 file may be worth adding once M1 is fully frozen so accidental resigns are caught by that suite too (iteration 4 adds this explicit ==25 assertion in test_m1_iter4_post_resign.py::TestBundleV25 and a post-guard-tests version invariant, which is sufficient for now).

success_rate.backend: 100% (107 passed, 1 gated-skip on GD_ALLOW_LIVE_RESIGN; +11/11 new iter4 spec tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter4 spec assertions verified on the live public URL)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only run. POST /api/rules/sign was only exercised with confirm=false (409) or rulesetId='gd-other-ruleset' (403); the controlled ruleset was NEVER signed with confirm:true. Bundle re-verified at v25 after all tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://guard-dog-m1.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin header for negative signing guards: X-GuardDog-Admin-Token: m1-dev-admin-token-change-me. NEVER call POST /api/rules/sign for rulesetId='gd-m1-controlled-block' with confirm:true unless GD_ALLOW_LIVE_RESIGN=1 is explicitly requested by the user — the M1 bundle is FROZEN at v25 (keyId=gd-m1-test-ed25519-001, payloadHash=2581666cc768e1e4e76962db0cc70e497e17e9b9cf4a5a997c8cfb091e6b90c9). Iter4 post-resign spec tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_m1_iter4_post_resign.py and include an explicit 'bundle still v25 after guard tests' invariant to catch accidental resigns. On web, the harness correctly emits step 'before' PASS via opaque no-cors GET; step 'consent' BLOCKED and step 'start' SKIPPED — native VPN/route/packet-capture steps are structurally unreachable on the web runtime, and this is spec, not a bug. Do not click [data-testid="export-pdf-button"] in headless runs (opens print dialog). The Recovery Checklist rendering (report-recovery row) only appears when protection actually started; on web it correctly stays absent because start=SKIPPED.
rca_of_issue: No product defects detected. All post-resign state (backend v25 + honest harness output + recovery=null + no simulated THREAT_BLOCKED) is consistent with the spec. The 'proof incomplete' verdict and BLOCKED/SKIPPED step statuses on web preview are correct and intentional: the harness never fabricates THREAT_BLOCKED and gates recovery reporting on real protection start. Bundle version invariant (v25) is preserved through the full test run and re-verified after the last test.
